text.en:
Paragraph (e), subsection A of section one of Act Numbered Thirty-eight hundred and thirteen is
hereby amended so that item four on page twenty-one under the caption "Occidental Misamis" shall read as
"4. For the Oroquieta Home Economics Building ....................... P3,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1932.
